name: The Origin of the Bhuta-Kāna
aspect: The sacred legend of how the Bhuta-Kāna fig tree grew from a celestial moon-seed to become the living record of the anci
notes: The sacred legend of how the Bhuta-Kāna fig tree grew from a celestial moon-seed to become the living record of the ancient world's memories. A silver-leaved oracle fig that whispers the voices of the forest in the evening breeze. The botanical preservation of Jambanson's infallible memory after his physical death.
sources: Roots and Whispers: The Legacy of the Bhuta-Kāna Tree
The Mythic Legacy and Ritual Order of Jambenson
